name: Fight
overview: Scripture reveals that the believer's fight is ultimately spiritual rather than physical, as Ephesians 6:12 emphasizes our struggle is against unseen spiritual forces of evil. We are called to rely on God's protection by putting on His full armor to stand firm in times of spiritual battle (Ephesians 6:13). Exodus 14:14 reassures us that the Lord fights on our behalf, inviting us to trust Him and remain peaceful rather than engaging in quarrels or initiating conflict ourselves.
